answer: For a poll on whether paths should wander along the terrace above the tide, each ballot needs three unused rostered sponsors, each signing and locking a separate $10 bond for this election. The server checks signatures, bonds and sponsor reuse, rejecting failures. A judge reviews duplicate-voter evidence; if persuaded, the judge rejects the ballot and forfeits its sponsors' bonds. Extra ballots need three more sponsors, potentially costing recruitment effort. Collusion and undetected duplicates remain risks.
